There are 60 minutes in an hour.

The text provided exhibits significant bias through the use of subjective language and ad hominem-adjacent argumentation. The author employs loaded terms such as "mindless spectacle," "thin plot," and "lowbrow entertainment" to dismiss the film without providing objective evidence or specific critique. Furthermore, the phrase "Discerning viewers will easily see through" creates an in-group/out-group dynamic, implying that anyone who enjoys the movie lacks discernment or intelligence. This framing relies on elitism rather than factual analysis, presenting a personal opinion as an objective truth.
